# Career Skills Center

> Career Skills Center is developing online career-focused training for Massachusetts adults in information technology, medical billing and coding, and (planned) the skilled trades. Programs are in development; details, credentials, length and pricing will be announced before enrollment opens. Based in Quincy, MA. Phone: (617) 544-7155. Email: info@careerskillscenter.com.

## Programs (in development)
- [Our Programs](https://careerskillscenter.com/our-programs.html): Overview of the fields Career Skills Center is developing training for.
- [Information Technology](https://careerskillscenter.com/it-support-specialist.html): An online IT support program in development for Massachusetts adults. Details coming before enrollment opens.
- [Medical Billing & Coding](https://careerskillscenter.com/medical-billing-coding.html): An online medical billing and coding program in development for Massachusetts adults. Details coming before enrollment opens.
- [Skilled Trades](https://careerskillscenter.com/skilled-trades.html): Planned skilled trades training. Coming soon.

## Admissions & Cost
- [Admissions](https://careerskillscenter.com/admissions.html): How enrollment will work, and how to join the interest list.
- [Tuition](https://careerskillscenter.com/tuition.html): Pricing coming soon; full costs published before enrollment opens.
- [Ways to Pay](https://careerskillscenter.com/student-financing.html): Planned payment options, employer-paid training, and state funding you may qualify for.
